desk-asana's project tab opens large projects again with task keys on, and the key field setting takes the field's name in any case.

- With `asanaKeyField` set, opening a project with many tasks failed with "result exceeds maximum allowed tokens": the custom fields made the 100-task page larger than Claude Code's MCP result limit. The pane now reads 50 tasks a page with task keys on, and when a page is still too large it reads it again at half the size and goes on to the next page, so the whole list still loads. The smaller size is remembered for the session
- My tasks and search go through the same reading, so a large list there no longer fails either
- `asanaKeyField` matches the field name in any case (`jkd` finds the `JKD` field), and its description says to use the name shown next to the value in a task's details, not the field's ID

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
